name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::back
intro: Returns reference to the last character in the string. The behavior is undefined if empty() is true.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reference to the last character, equivalent to operator[](size() - 1).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In libstdc++, back() is not available in C++98 mode.
